```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}" ]; then
            echo "TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=${{ env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=${{ env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Test
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal
```
